name: Supine Arms: Triceps Press
stable: Pelvis, spine, legs and upper arms
summary: Legs in tabletop, upper arms pinned to the carriage: the elbows bend to point the fingers at the ceiling and press down again.
steps: Lie on the back, legs in tabletop, hands in the short loops, arms long beside the hips.
Breathe in to bend the elbows to a right angle, fingertips up.
Breathe out to press the hands down and straighten the arms.

layers.title: Hover the elbows
layers.text: Lift the elbows a couple of centimetres and keep them there.

layers.title: Add legs
layers.text: Single or double leg reach, scissors.

cautions.note: Lying flat on the back: keep it to a few minutes, raise the head end if you can, and stop if she feels dizzy.

cues:
Upper arms stay on the carriage.
Knees over hips; no arching.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
